revenue.source: Honeywell FY2025 Annual Report (ARS, accession 0000773840-26-000031), consolidated statement of operations, continuing operations (restated for Solstice spin-off)

operating_income.source: not found on the restated continuing-operations basis (search tool limit reached). Originally reported pre-restatement figures were 7,084 (FY2023) and 7,441 (FY2024) per FY2024 annual report, but are not comparable with the restated revenue, so not used

d_and_a.source: stockanalysis.com HON cash flow statement (D&A, restated continuing basis); secondary source, not verified to the 10-K

capex.source: stockanalysis.com HON cash flow statement (capital expenditures, restated continuing basis); secondary source, not verified to the 10-K

revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY2025 growth was 7.9% (37,442 vs 34,717) helped by acquisitions; fade to mid-single-digit organic growth typical of diversified industrial/automation peers.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: restated EBIT not found. Originally reported FY2024 operating margin was about 19.3% (7,441/38,498, FY2024 annual report); haircut for restatement/stranded costs. Reviewer should verify.

tax_rate.source: Assumption: US statutory 21%; Honeywell's effective rate is roughly 19-22%.

wacc.source: Assumption: beta ~1.0, risk-free ~4.3%, ERP ~5%, after-tax cost of debt ~4%, ~15% debt weight, giving roughly 8.5%.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: long-run nominal GDP/inflation-like growth, below WACC.

net_debt.source: Derived: long-term debt 27,141 + current maturities 1,546 + commercial paper/short-term borrowings ~5,900 (stated as $5.9bn at 12/31/2025) - cash 12,487 - short-term investments 443. Sources: Honeywell 4Q25 release tables and 2026 10-Q snippets. Long-term debt column attribution is uncertain, so verify.

diluted_shares.source: Honeywell 4Q25 financial release tables: weighted average shares assuming dilution, full-year 2025 = 642.8 million (shares in millions, same scale as money)
